name: distribute
description: Turn customer calls and workspace context into grounded, branded Distribute pages.

interface.longDescription: Create and update branded Distribute pages from customer calls and workspace context, build account maps, and review engagement analytics. New pages follow workspace sharing defaults and may be viewable by anyone with the link. Review source grounding, uncertainty and visibility before sharing.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn a customer call into a branded follow-up page. Check the workspace sharing defaults and explain the resulting visibility.
